trustSignals.label: Written contract with deposit protection
trustSignals.description: A standalone section on every page confirming the homeowner's deposit is protected by a written contract specifying scope, timeline, and payment schedule.
trustSignals.placement: standalone section between gallery and team
trustSignals.rationale: The #1 homeowner fear in this niche is losing a deposit to a contractor who disappears or does substandard work. No competitor addresses this directly. Addressing it wins trust immediately.

trustSignals.label: Satisfaction guarantee
trustSignals.description: A bold guarantee statement - if you are not satisfied we will make it right or refund you.
trustSignals.placement: hero section below CTAs or as a badge in the trust bar
trustSignals.rationale: sweeneyslandscaping.com (top scorer) uses this as a prominent hero element. It removes purchase risk and signals confidence in the work quality.

trustSignals.label: Google review aggregate with star rating and count
trustSignals.description: Display the aggregate Google rating (e.g. 4.9 stars across 127 reviews) with a direct link to the Google listing.
trustSignals.rationale: Homeowners check Google reviews before calling any home service contractor. Surfacing this on the page removes the friction of searching separately.

trustSignals.label: License number and insurance statement
trustSignals.description: Display the contractor license number and a clear statement of full insurance coverage, with a note that the certificate is available on request.
trustSignals.placement: footer, contact page, and as a trust bar item in the hero
trustSignals.rationale: Unlicensed or uninsured contractors are a real risk. Homeowners who have been burned before look for this explicitly.

trustSignals.label: Named crew with real photos
trustSignals.description: Owner headshot and bio plus named crew members with roles and photos.
trustSignals.placement: team section on homepage and about page
trustSignals.rationale: Home service is personal. A named, visible team reduces the fear of strangers on the property and signals the business is accountable.
